newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - March 27.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS -- Issues to watch - March 27.

text.p: * Motorola Inc shares reversed course and fell to 60-1/2 from 62 in after-hours trading Wednesday following a company report that quarterly earnings will decline until later this year.

* Philip Morris Cos Inc shares slipped 1/2 to 118-7/8 in London after news that a Mississippi judge had ruled that internal documents from Liggett Group could be turned over to plaintiffs in a $650 million second-hand-smoke lawsuit.

* Shares of Quaker Oats Co were bid at 38-5/8 ahead of the opening bell on Wall Street, up from their close at 37-1/2. The company is selling its Snapple unit to Triarc Cos Inc for $300 million cash. Triarc closed at 15-3/4.

* Gucci Group NV shares rallied ahead of the U.S. market open, as buyers came in on learning of the luxury goods company's sharply higher fiscal 1996 earnings. Ahead of the opening bell, Gucci's New York Stock Exchange-listed shares jumped to 76 from 70-7/8.
